name: ollama
description: Official Ollama images for Nvidia or AMD GPUs. Intel Arc GPUs could potentially work with Vulkan enabled. NOTE: Extra Parameters needed for Nvidia: --gpus=all Additionally you can add a Variable called CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to only use specific Nvidia GPU(s) by ID. Example: 0 or 0,1 Extra Parameters needed for AMD: --device='/dev/kfd' --device='/dev/dri' Additionally you can add a Variable called ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES to only use specific AMD GPU(s) by UUID. Example: GPU-67246603a11f0a21 or GPU-XXXXXXX,GPU-YYYYYYY Docs: https://docs.ollama.com/

ports.name: API Interface Port
ports.description: Port number where ollama listens on.

variables.name: OLLAMA_HOST
variables.description: IP and Port the server binds to. Set to 127.0.0.1:11434 for internal only access.

variables.name: OLLAMA_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins.

variables.name: OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE
variables.description: How long a model stays in VRAM, e.g. 60m or 24h (Set to -1 for infinite, 0 for none).

variables.name: OLLAMA_LOAD_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Timeout for stall detection during model loads.

variables.name: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL
variables.description: Max number of parallel requests a single model can handle.

variables.name: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH
variables.description: Default context window (tokens) if not specified by the model.

variables.name: OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE
variables.description: Quantization type for the K/V cache, e.g. f16, q8_0, q4_0.

variables.name: OLLAMA_MODELS
variables.description: The path where model weights and blobs are stored.

variables.name: OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS
variables.description: Maximum number of models loaded per GPU at once (Set to 0 for infinite).

variables.name: OLLAMA_MAX_QUEUE
variables.description: Max requests that can wait in line when the server is busy.

variables.name: OLLAMA_DEBUG
variables.description: Log detail level: 0 for INFO, 1 for DEBUG, 2 for TRACE.

variables.name: OLLAMA_GPU_OVERHEAD
variables.description: Reserved VRAM (in bytes) to leave empty on each GPU.

variables.name: OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION
variables.description: Enables experimental Flash Attention optimizations.

variables.name: OLLAMA_SCHED_SPREAD
variables.description: If true, always spreads model layers across all visible GPUs.

variables.name: OLLAMA_MULTIUSER_CACHE
variables.description: Optimizes prompt caching when multiple users share a model.

variables.name: OLLAMA_NOPRUNE
variables.description: If true, does not delete unused model blobs on startup.

variables.name: OLLAMA_NOHISTORY
variables.description: Disables the readline history in the interactive CLI.

variables.name: OLLAMA_NEW_ENGINE
variables.description: Enables the experimental new Ollama engine.

variables.name: OLLAMA_VULKAN
variables.description: Enables experimental Vulkan hardware acceleration.

variables.name: HTTP_PROXY
variables.description: Proxy for downloading models over HTTP.

variables.name: HTTPS_PROXY
variables.description: Proxy for downloading models over HTTPS.

variables.name: NO_PROXY
variables.description: Comma-separate list of hosts/IPs that bypass the proxy.
